title: Qwen3.6-27B sole-Q5T16 source-F16 bounded rocBLAS leaf
performance_claim_scope: actual immutable blk.0.ssm_out K6144/N5120 component leaf on RX 7900 XTX and W7900; no model runtime, prefill throughput, decode, memory, MTP, or default claim

change.arithmetic: source-F16 weight expansion, BF16-to-FP16 activation cast, rocBLAS FP16 compute/output, and BF16 output cast; changed association versus exact Q5T16 WMMA
change.fallback: existing exact Q5T16 dense WMMA; all runtime behavior remains unchanged

protocol.input: one actual immutable model tensor plus deterministic BF16 random activation per M
protocol.timing: three warmups and 15 counterordered HIP-event pairs per candidate; complete candidate includes activation cast, every bounded Q5T16-to-F16 tile, rocBLAS GEMM, and strided FP16-to-BF16 publication

correctness.source_f16_bytes: Q5T16 tile producer is FP16-bit exact to an independent raw-Q5 source-F16 CPU oracle on a deterministic K512/N32 fixture
correctness.cpu_gate: bounded Q5T16 source-F16 composite passes the project KL<=0.05/top1>=90% gate versus cpu_reference gguf_q5_k_gemv
correctness.actual_leaf: changed association is explicit; actual-weight row top-1 is 98.05-98.29% for selected tiles, not a substitute for the full model/category gate

trace.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-qwen36-27b-single-layout-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv -d /tmp/qwen36-q5-f16-rocprof-smoke -o q5-f16-m512 -- /home/lhl/mambaforge/envs/therock/bin/python /tmp/qwen36_q5_t16_f16_rocblas_screen.py --rows 512 --tiles 1280 --warmups 0 --samples 1
trace.note: Profiler timing is perturbative and is used only to prove the expected named kernel executed with plausible duration.

validation.red: focused registry and source-F16 byte tests failed because the Q5 producer and route did not exist

decision: Retain the isolated producer/composite registry primitive because it is source-F16-correct, zero-resident-byte, cross-board uniformly faster, and has a required exact fallback. Keep it runtime-unwired until a separate model-scoped changed-arithmetic quality and full-prefill gate passes.
